$comment: #805 and #834 organic flags on fertilizer plugins, same rule as the complianceFlags section of epa-reg-sources.json (#779): a plugin may set omriListed, certifiedOrganicAllowed or transitioningAllowed to true only with an entry here, either an OMRI Products List NOP listing ({ omriListed: true, sourceUrl on omri.org, quote "<product> | <company> | <OMRI code> | NOP | <status> | expires <date>" }) or, for a generic plugin that names no brand, a 7 CFR 205 quote that names the material ({ basis: "7 CFR 205", citation, sourceUrl on ecfr.gov, quote }), which never sets omriListed. #834: certifiedOrganicAllowed: false also needs an entry ({ certifiedOrganicAllowed: false, basis, citation, sourceUrl, quote }), either an unconditional 7 CFR 205.602 paragraph whose quote holds the entry's `material`, or 205.105(a) with the 205.2 `definition` of synthetic quoted and an `inference` line that says it is the app's own; an entry with this field needs the plugin to carry the false mark. omriListed: false entries record why a plugin carries no flag. Rulings F805-1 to F805-4 and F834-1 to F834-7 in docs/design/LABEL_FOLLOWUP_RULINGS.md. eCFR text up to date as of 2026-10-08. Checked by fertilizerOrganicSources.gate.test.ts.
